“%1$s” needs a password to open. To send it to the AI model, Switchboard decrypts it on this device and uploads the decrypted copy. The password never leaves your device.

Password-protected files often contain sensitive information. The decrypted copy is stored on your LibreChat server and shared with the AI provider. Only continue if you're comfortable sharing its contents.

Enables adaptive thinking controlled by the Effort parameter. This model cannot turn thinking off entirely: switching this off uses its lowest setting, which skips extended thinking and keeps only brief notes between tool calls. Effort is capped at High while off.
